# ZURA

> ZURA is a single-ingredient, cold-pressed Moroccan argan oil brand built for aesthetic and corrective clinics, and for retail customers seeking a clinical-grade, traceable skincare oil.

ZURA sells one product: a 50ml bottle of pure Argania Spinosa Kernel Oil (Moroccan argan oil), cold-pressed and unrefined, with no dilution, fragrance, or filler. Every batch is independently lab-tested for oleic acid content and peroxide value, and results are traceable to the batch number printed on the bottle. The company is ISO 22716 (cosmetic GMP) certified.

## Product

- Name: ZURA Moroccan Argan Oil
- Format: 50ml / 1.7 fl oz, airless pump bottle
- INCI: Argania Spinosa Kernel Oil
- Origin: Morocco (single-origin, certified)
- Processing: Cold-pressed, unrefined
- Shelf life: 24 months from press date
- Retail price: $60 USD
- Clinic retail range: $50-$60 USD. Wholesale unit pricing is tiered by order volume and provided directly to approved clinics after application; it is not published publicly.
- Purchase: https://www.zura.beauty/#product

## Who it's for

- Aesthetic and corrective skincare clinics retailing to patients
- Estheticians and clinicians using it in post-procedure protocols (post-peel, post-microneedling, compromised skin barrier recovery)
- Retail customers wanting a single-ingredient, non-comedogenic, acne-safe facial oil
